skill_name: Name one thing that you could do to reduce your environmental footprint.
workflow: One simple way to reduce your environmental footprint is to switch to energy-efficient solutions every time you buy or replace electronics and appliances. Energy-efficient solutions consume less energy, require less electricity to use, and usually offer a long-term saving in electricity bills. Additionally, you can reduce your consumption of single-use plastics such as plastic water bottles, straws and grocery bags. Instead, opt to use reusable or recyclable items when possible.
